name: hyreflow
description: Source, enrich, qualify, sequence, and push candidates to your ATS from your agent. Drives the Hyreflow CLI and MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Recruiting automation: source, enrich, and reach candidates.
interface.longDescription:
Hyreflow gives your agent a full recruiting and go-to-market toolkit in one connection. Search for people and companies, enrich contacts with verified work emails and phone numbers through a waterfall of 40+ data providers, qualify them against your criteria, run outreach sequences, and push results into your ATS or CRM — all metered on one credit balance, with the agent shown the cost before anything is spent.

Sign in with your existing Hyreflow account; new accounts start with free credits. Every spend is confirmed first, and read-only tools (search the catalog, check your balance, read datasets) never charge.
defaultPrompt: Call hyreflow_billing_balance to check my credit balance, then describe the cheapest way to find work emails for one person.
Use Hyreflow to find 10 senior backend engineers in Berlin with verified emails. Show me each step's cost before running it.
Use Hyreflow to list my saved workflows and show the last three runs of each.
